canonical_statement: For a complex semisimple Lie algebra and a regular integral infinitesimal character (with a compatible dominant weight convention), localization and global sections give mutually quasi-inverse equivalences between the corresponding central-character block of modules over the enveloping algebra and the category of quasi-coherent twisted D-modules on the flag variety.
domain_and_universes: Future exact target: a characteristic-zero/complex semisimple Lie algebra g, its flag variety X, a regular integral weight/infinitesimal character, a central reduction of U(g), and categories of modules and twisted D-modules. The legacy Lean boundary instead quantifies abstract categories RepCat : Type u and DModCat : Type v.
quantifiers: g: complex semisimple Lie algebra (exact finite-dimensional/root-data package open)
lambda: regular integral weight with the dominance convention needed for the abelian theorem
M: objects of the selected central-character module block and F: twisted D_lambda-modules
hypotheses: characteristic zero over the complex numbers
semisimplicity of g and the full flag variety X
regularity, integrality, and compatible dominance of lambda
the selected quasi-coherence and central-character/block conditions
conclusion: The localization and global-sections functors are equivalences of categories and quasi-inverse to each other.
